app.name: Lotería de los Pueblos
app.tagline: A lotería game to play with family, with cards inspired by the peoples of the Americas.

print.intro: Make PDF boards to play on paper. Works offline.
print.checkCodeHelp: Each board has a code so the cantor can check it.
print.noPhoneBody: Print the boards, hand out beans, and let the cantor use the screen. To check a paper board, the cantor types its 6-character code.

credits.title: Credits
credits.artBody: The artwork in this version is Unicode emoji rendered by your system font. Original art will be commissioned later.
credits.namesBody: The Spanish and English verses and riddles were written by the team. Names in Indigenous languages await native-speaker review.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: There are no accounts and no tracking cookies. Your name, symbol and marks stay on your device.
